description: Single screen for smoke/baseline/load/stress/spike/soak tests: k6 load, RPS, latency vs SLO, errors, saturation, DB, cache, edge and HPA.

panels.title: Test KPIs vs success criteria (1m windows)

panels.description: Requests/s completed by the API. Design point: ~116 req/s peak, 500 req/s headroom.
panels.title: Server RPS

panels.description: SLO: average < 300 ms.
panels.title: Avg latency

panels.description: k6 threshold: p(95) < 500 ms.
panels.title: P95 latency

panels.description: Tail latency.
panels.title: P99 latency

panels.description: Scraped API replicas (watch it grow as the HPA scales out).
panels.title: Replicas serving

panels.description: Busiest replica's CPU as a fraction of its 1-core limit. SLO: < 80%.

panels.description: Busiest replica's RSS as a fraction of the 512Mi limit. SLO: < 80%.
panels.title: Max memory / replica

panels.description: Only populated when k6 runs with -o experimental-prometheus-rw and Prometheus has --web.enable-remote-write-receiver.
panels.title: k6 virtual users

panels.description: Total and per-route request rate.
panels.title: Requests / sec (RPS)

panels.title: CPU per replica (cores)
